result.summary: The residual raw-double leak on the Activity/Nutrition Evidence headline, subheadline, Activity Areas, protocol-support/trend, Web hub metric, and Evidence-timeline strings is fixed -- but it was never a Native defect: those strings are built server-side and decoded verbatim, so the fix is Server code (3 commits, final 4b362591, one shared whole-number helper mirroring the Native cards). Two adversarial review passes; all three findings fixed and re-verified; final re-audit clean in scope. No Native change, so no Build 54 is needed for this. Not deployed (code/test/review only): it takes effect on the next Server deploy, which needs the Founder's go-ahead.

tests.summary: Server: new HealthKitEvidenceSummaryFormatting.test.js 9/9 driving the real exported builders with the Founder's exact reported values plus the reviewer's .5-tie vectors; phase3 282/283 (the one failure is the pre-existing gitignored private/founder/runtime-store.json fixture, present before any change), foundation 38/38, phase2 97/97, phase4 137/137; eslint clean. Mutation-tested three times (each hunk reverted in isolation fails exactly its own tests, reproducing the reported strings; restores byte-identical). Native untouched at 1c57556f: unit 1289/1289; UI target 12/12 across two runs -- one environmental flake on an untouched Training journey (testReportingJourneys, 809 s full run) passed in 44.5 s re-run in isolation, disclosed in the report.

review.summary: Fresh-context adversarial review (isolated worktree) of 44edddb7 verified guarding, rounding parity with Swift, behavior preservation, real test path, hygiene, and found two in-scope misses (formatActivityProtocolSupport feeding the headline card's protocolStatus/report trend/hub trend; formatActivityHubMetric feeding the Web hub) -- fixed in d2aa86e0 with tests. Delta verification confirmed both and caught one last real 1-off (difference-rounding not tie-safe vs the cards) -- fixed in 4b362591 exactly as prescribed, with the reviewer's tie vectors as tests. Final re-audit: no remaining raw HealthKit-double interpolation on any Activity/Nutrition Evidence surface, Native or Web; only the task-excluded Training sites remain.

zero_write_audit.summary: No production mutation: nothing deployed, no archive/upload, no canary, no manual Sync, Workout activation untouched. Authority reverified before acting (deployment 0bdc1748 ACTIVE on ccff693b via its own source_commit_hash; Native 1c57556f clean). All work on a fresh branch from the deployed commit; only the branch and the handoff files were pushed.
